messages:
nina: FYI competitor "SkyServe" running a splash claiming 'plug-and-play on any GPU' with a latency graphic. need micro-rebut + two SDR lines by lunchtime.
mona: please keep to one short sentence per SDR line.
kai: core point: 'plug-and-play' ignores workload patterns. we tune kernels, batching, and caching.
rhea: SDR lines (draft):
- Tech: 'Runtime tuned to your model and traffic for reliable latency.'
- Biz: 'Predictable latency and transparent unit-cost controls across deployment types.'
mona: swap 'reliable' for 'improved' to avoid legal hotwash.
kai: webinar bullets (short): Serving-first runtime; cost controls (batching/caching); observability (token-level breakdowns).
nina: action: @kai drop final 2 SDR lines in Notion by 12:30 PT, @rhea make 1-slide with the bullets by EOD.
ops-bot: Reminder set: Notion drop due 12:30 PT (channel: #marketing).
mona: thanks. keep it punchy, no jargon.
